142	// at `off` within the flat [m|v|extra] layout. Per-TENSOR fields and all scalars

146	template <OptId Opt>
147	__device__ __forceinline__ FusedOptState
148	vit_rebase_state(const FusedOptState& s, int64_t off) {
149	    FusedOptState t = s;  // scalars + per-tensor pointers copy as-is
150	    if (t.exp_avg)    t.exp_avg    += off;
151	    if (t.exp_avg_sq) t.exp_avg_sq += off;
152	    if (t.ema)        t.ema        += off;
153	    if (t.sam_dir)    t.sam_dir    += off;

158	    if (t.param_init) t.param_init += off;   // Prodigy trajectory anchor p0

165	// The L3-REAL ViT megakernel needs the FLOAT patch path + a grad-partial
166	// workspace. Kept a SEPARATE kernel + launcher (not folded into the surrogate
167	// fused_megakernel) so the surrogate path is untouched.
168	//
169	// Workspace layout (one flat float buffer the host allocates + the kernel owns):
170	//   [0 .. nCTA*total)              : per-CTA grad partials (cta-major)
171	//   [nCTA*total .. nCTA*total+nCTA): per-CTA loss partials (NLL sum per slice)
172	//   [.. +1)                        : the reduced scalar loss (loss/B) the host reads
173	// total == kVitTotalElems == 418017.
174	struct ViTInputCtx {
175	    const float* patches;  // [B, kNPatch, kPatch] fp32 image patches
176	    const int*   targets;  // [B]                  int32 target ids in [0,kVocab)
177	    int          B;        // batch size
178	    float*       workspace; // grad partials + loss partials + reduced loss
179	    float*       loss_out;  // device float the kernel writes the mean loss into
180	};

182	#if SG_VIT_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL
183	// ── The persistent megakernel (L3-REAL). gridDim.x = #SMs (one CTA/SM), 256
184	//    threads/CTA. VitSampleSmem (~183.67 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (extern). ────
185	//    GATED by SG_VIT_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL (this fp32 path's VitSampleSmem grows with
186	//    SG_VIT_D and overflows the 227 KB dynamic-smem cap at the bench width; OFF lets
187	//    the TC path build at scaled d — see the flag note above). ────────────────────
188	// sizes/offsets are NOT host-passed: per-tensor numel/offset live in the
189	// __constant__ tables kVitSizes/kVitOffsets (vit_layout.cuh), read directly by
190	// the reduce + optimizer phases.
191	template <OptId Opt>
192	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK)
193	fused_vit_megakernel(PersistentContext ctx,
194	                     float* __restrict__ params,
195	                     ViTInputCtx in,
196	                     float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
197	                     float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
198	    extern __shared__ char vit_smem_raw[];
199	    VitSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<VitSampleSmem*>(vit_smem_raw);
200	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
201	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
202	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
203	    const int64_t total = kVitTotalElems;
204	    float* my_partial = in.workspace + (int64_t)cta * total;   // this CTA's dW
205	    float* loss_part = in.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]
206	
207	    // §3.4 register repartition (producer WG gives back, consumer WG claims).
208	    const int wg = threadIdx.x / 128;
209	    if (wg == 0) ::sg::sm90::wgs::warpgroup_reg_dealloc<32>();
210	    else         ::sg::sm90::wgs::warpgroup_reg_alloc<200>();
211	
212	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
213	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
214	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
215	    bar.sync();   // B0
216	
217	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
218	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
219	    VitGrad g = vit_bind_grad(my_partial);
220	    const int B = in.B;
221	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
222	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
223	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
224	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
225	    __shared__ int tgt_s;
226	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
227	    const int patch_elems = vit::kNPatch * vit::kPatch;   // 16*49 = 784
228	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
229	        // Load this sample's float patches into smem (cooperative).
230	        const float* src = in.patches + (int64_t)b * patch_elems;
231	        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < patch_elems; i += blockDim.x)
232	            sm.patch[i / vit::kPatch][i % vit::kPatch] = src[i];
233	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = in.targets[b];
234	        __syncthreads();
235	        float nll = vit_forward_sample(w, tgt_s, &sm);
236	        vit_backward_sample(w, g, tgt_s, B, &sm);
237	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
238	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
239	    }
240	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
241	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
242	
243	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
244	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
245	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
246	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
247	    {
248	        __shared__ int task_slot;
249	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
250	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;
251	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
252	            const int n = kVitSizes[t];
253	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kVitOffsets[t];
254	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
255	                float acc = 0.0f;
256	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
257	                    acc += in.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
258	                grad[off + i] = acc;
259	            }
260	        }
261	    }
262	    // Loss reduction (fp64 ordered) by CTA 0 only — the loss rel-tol is the
263	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
264	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
265	        double s = 0.0;
266	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
267	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
268	        *in.loss_out = mean;
269	    }
270	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3
271	
272	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 32
273	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
274	    st.lr = lr;
275	    {
276	        __shared__ int task_slot;
277	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
278	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;
279	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
280	            const int n = kVitSizes[t];
281	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kVitOffsets[t];
282	            const FusedOptState ts = vit_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);
283	            float* __restrict__ p = params + off;
284	            const float* __restrict__ gg = grad + off;
285	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x)
286	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);
287	        }
288	    }
289	}

291	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
292	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
293	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the ViT footprint requires:
294	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sizeof(VitSampleSmem))
295	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) in the occ≥1 query
296	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) at <<<...>>>
297	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
298	template <OptId Opt>
299	cudaError_t launch_fused_vit_megakernel(
300	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, ViTInputCtx in,
301	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
302	    int dev = 0;
303	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
304	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
305	    int n_sms = 0;
306	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
307	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
308	
309	    const int dyn_smem = (int)sizeof(VitSampleSmem);   // ≈ 188080 B (183.67 KB)
310	
311	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
312	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
313	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
314	        (const void*)&fused_vit_megakernel<Opt>,
315	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
316	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
317

Each CTA owns a FIXED contiguous batch slice (blockIdx.x); whole CTA cooperates on ONE
sample at a time, iterates its slice SEQUENTIALLY; each dW element has a SINGLE owner
thread doing `partial[e] += contrib` in fixed sample order (__syncthreads between samples)

fused_vit_megakernel.cuh (ascending-CTA order).

### Backward execution mechanic (documented deviation = mechanics, not numerics)
Backward RECOMPUTES each layer's forward from the cached layer INPUT (`layer_in[li]`)
rather than caching every intermediate, to keep only one layer's activations live in smem
(lines 17-22, 504-542 `vit_recompute_layer`). Running adjoint `dh` is preserved across the

### vit_linear_bwd LEADING-DIMENSION contract (HISTORICAL BUG, now fixed — lines 583-633)

width (kDff=512 for ff0/gact) DIFFERS from the logical row width (kD=128, 3kD=384). The
prior packed-stride form silently read/wrote WRONG rows at both attention-seam call sites:
only row 0 partially landed, rows 1.. hit stale recomputed values → forward stayed exact
while every grad upstream of attention was garbage (params decayed to zero under weight
decay; train acc pinned at 1/97). The CPU mirror does NOT catch it (semantic indexing,
not flat offset), so the stride is now part of the call contract. Two call sites pass
non-trivial strides:
- out_proj bwd: dctx written into ff0 at ldDX=kDff (lines 833-835) — attn-bwd readers
  (A@851, B@866) read it as `sm->ff0[qi][col]`.
- in_proj bwd: dqkv read from gact at ldY=kDff (lines 902-905) — a packed 3d=384 read would
  walk row 0 into stale dq/dk/dv in gact[0][384:512].

### Attention backward — 3 synced passes (FULL, no causal triangle), lines 836-896
A: dv into gact[:,2d:3d]; B: dscores into `dsc` (`attn` read, never overwritten);
C: dq into gact[:,0:d], dk into gact[:,d:2d]. Then in_proj bwd.

### Embedding backward (lines 914-943)
pos.weight[s]+=dh[s] (ALL 17 positions); cls_token+=dh[0]; patch_proj weight/bias from
rows 1..16 against live `sm->patch` pixels (owner-thread per (o,i)/(o)).

### `inline` (vague-linkage) on the 5 non-template __device__ free fns (lines 396-403)
Required because this header is now pulled by TWO co-resident _ops TUs (the scalar
launcher AND the wired TC launcher -DSG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL=1) — without `inline` they emit

## 4. Findings — bugs / risks / dead-ish / inconsistencies
================================================================================

### Risk / contract (not necessarily a bug)
- **Muon NS scratch sizing vs the 2D table**: scratch (fused_vit_megakernel.cuh:434-442)
  sizes kVitMuonMaxNumel=kDff·kD=65536, kVitMuonMaxRows=kDff=512, with muon_A=512²=262144.
  The kVitMuon2D table (model_stage_vit_tc.cuh:191-203) max numel = 65536 (ff0/ff2), max
  rows = 512 (ff0). For in_proj rows=384 (A=384²) and out.weight rows=97 (A=97²) — both
  ≤ allocated. **CHECKED OK** (no overflow), but the sizing literals kVitMuonMaxNumel/Rows
  are HAND-DERIVED in megakernel while the table lives in vit_tc — if a wider 2D weight is
  ever added to the table, the megakernel scratch literals will NOT auto-update (no
  static_assert ties them together). RISK, not a live bug.

### Comment inconsistencies (cleanup, not behavior)
- vit_layout.cuh:34 ("d=2048, HEADS=32") vs fused_vit_megakernel.cuh:118 ("d=1024 ... ≈1.4MB")
  describe the bench width differently. CODE is D=2048 (vit_layout.cuh:53) → VitSampleSmem
  ≈2.86MB (vit_layout.cuh:161), not 1.4MB. Stale comment in the flag note only.
- fused_vit_megakernel.cuh:960-961 says the NS result lands "in muon_X iff ns_steps even
  else muon_orth (we track the parity below)", but the swap is performed AFTER EVERY combine
  (line 975), so `muon_X` ALWAYS holds the latest iterate regardless of parity — which is
  what lines 977-978 + 984 (`orth_final = pw.muon_X`) actually rely on. The "iff even/odd"
  comment is misleading/contradictory but the CODE is correct (ns_steps=5, result in
  muon_X). Comment-only defect.

### No dead code among the assigned ViT trees
- The scalar `fused_vit_megakernel` path is NOT dead — it is the gated (default-ON) fp32
  baseline / oracle twin and the L3-REAL gate path. The TC path is the production perf path.
  Both PRESERVED by design. The 4 staged-opt carves are byte-identical no-ops for AdamW/Lion
  cells (correct, not dead).

### Determinism (HARD gate leg) — all reduction phases are A/A/A by construction
P2 cross-CTA reduce (ascending CTA), loss fp64 ordered (CTA0), P2.4 ‖g‖, P2.5 clip, P2.6
Prodigy d — all use FIXED contiguous per-CTA ranges + ascending owner-sum, NO float atomics
(fused_vit_megakernel.cuh:243-261, 264-269, 705-739, 824-855, 874-918). The codebase
explicitly chose the fixed-partition reduce over the work-steal drain for Prodigy precisely
to satisfy the deterministic-reduction contract (lines 874-888).
